fact_previews: Mi3 is an all-in-one music app that benefits consumers, DJs, and artists.
The app promotes aspiring artists' music to its users and allows users to purchase their work.
Angel is an aspiring artist who benefits from Mi3 by promoting her music and earning money from sales.
Mi3 allows users to promote music via popular social media outlets like Facebook and Twitter.
John is a DJ who can make money with his mixes using Mi3 and can be booked directly through the app.
